market.question: Will Ethereum dip to $2,000 in May?

assessment.reasoning: ETH is at ~$2,290 on May 7. Need a ~13% drop to $2,000 within next 24 days. ETH has been oscillating in the $2,290-$2,400 range; no break of major support yet. Crypto volatility could deliver but base rate over ~3.5 weeks is moderate-low.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Single sharp risk-off move in next 3.5 weeks could break $2,000.
